gloss_en: evil thoughts (machashavot ra'ot) — morally bad or impure thoughts arising in a person's mind, likened in Likutey Moharan I:233 to impure (non-kosher) animals set to battle against holy thoughts

outliers.actual_gloss_en: alien/foreign thoughts — distracting extraneous thoughts, specifically those that intrude during prayer, likened to clouds covering the eyes
outliers.reason: The text reads מַחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת (alien thoughts), a distinct phrase and distinct concept in LM I:2 (thoughts intruding in prayer due to corrupted judgment), not מחשבות רעות; the surface form does not even match the canonical Hebrew.
